avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 induction may accelerate propofol metabolism and reduce anesthetic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks before anesthesia; coordinate with anesthesia team

avoid_supplements.name: Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity combined with propofol's hepatic metabolism and potential for propofol infusion syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; discontinue at least 1 week prior to any scheduled procedures

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and sedation with propofol; increases risk of respiratory depression
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue 2-3 days before anesthesia; inform anesthesiologist of use

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation and mild CNS stimulation may variably affect propofol requirements
caution_supplements.action: Document use; monitor anesthetic depth; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild anticoagulant effects and potential CYP3A4 interaction; theoretical additive CNS depression
caution_supplements.action: Discontinue 1 week before elective procedures; disclose to anesthesia team

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive sedative effects may potentiate propofol's CNS depression
caution_supplements.action: Avoid on day of anesthesia; inform anesthesiologist of chronic use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase propofol levels and prolong anesthetic effects; risk of prolonged sedation
avoid_foods.action: Avoid for 48-72 hours before scheduled procedures requiring propofol

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase propofol absorption if taken orally (rare); potential for delayed gastric emptying affecting preoperative fasting requirements
caution_foods.action: Follow standard NPO (nothing by mouth) guidelines; coordinate with perioperative team

caution_foods.name: Caffeinated beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS stimulation may increase propofol requirements and affect anesthetic depth stability
caution_foods.action: Limit intake day-of procedure; disclose consumption to anesthesia team

monitoring_notes: Propofol is administered only in controlled clinical settings by trained anesthesia professionals; monitor vital signs, oxygen saturation, and depth of anesthesia throughout infusion. Watch for propofol infusion syndrome (PRIS) risk, particularly with prolonged infusions, and assess hepatic function and lipid clearance in at-risk patients.
